news.title: Beechside views: six people universities need to understand in Burnham’s Britain
news.summary_en: As Andy Burnham settles into No. 10, Diana Beech outlines the movers and shakers in his cabinet that UK universities should get to know.
news.author: Diana Beech

news.title: India reforms exams after protests force minister’s resignation
news.summary_en: New legislation, tougher penalties for exam malpractice and a wider review of India's examination system form the Modi government's biggest response yet to the NEET-UG crisis, though organisers warn the protest movement is far from over.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Should the UK capital’s higher ed institutions be ‘Londonmaxxing’?
news.summary_en: The Mayor of London has teamed up with London's institutions to make the case that the city is the higher education capital of the world. But what more can the city do to strengthen its case?
news.author: Beth Kennedy
